items.evidence: Total Revenue A leading indicator of performance and value creation; provides a clear focus on growth; an important measure in our industry
Adjusted Diluted EPS A measure of income that provides focus on profitable growth and expense control; viewed as a strong indicator of sustained performance over the long term
Cash Flow from Operations A measure that provides focus on generating cash in the short-term to fund operations and research
Aligns rewards to both a strategic financial performance metric NI (#) over three one-year periods and relative TSR
Why use relative TSR as a PSA metric? The relative TSR metric over the three-year performance period provides balance that is intended to drive performance
Provides direct alignment with shareholders as awards are tied to absolute TSR
